source: Adapted cross-reference, September 2026: en.wikipedia's history of the festival and its headliners, 'best Coachella performances' lists found by web search (A.V. Club, Numéro, Yahoo, Men's Journal: Beyoncé 2018, Daft Punk 2006, the Cure 2009, Radiohead 2004), and view counts read from YouTube on 2026-09-14: the festival's own channel (Coachella, @Coachella) sorted by popularity and searched for 'live at coachella', 'full set' and 'sahara'; Beyoncé's and Fatboy Slim's channels searched for 'coachella'. This site's catalogue (source 6 of FIGURES.md) holds no Coachella set. Every player is oEmbed-checked 14 September 2026.

required_records.title: Diljit Dosanjh
required_records.set: Diljit Dosanjh - G.O.A.T. - Live at Coachella 2023
required_records.why: about 10 million views on the festival's channel (2026-09-14); played in the Sahara tent on Saturday 15 April 2023 per the video description; evidence for the breadth of the Sahara in the music section

required_records.title: Losing It
required_records.set: FISHER - Losing It - Live at Coachella 2019 Friday April 12, 2019
required_records.why: the most watched video on the festival's own channel, about 77 million views (2026-09-14); a single track rather than a full set; Essential listening

required_records.title: Fatboy Slim
required_records.why: a full set, 1:56:47, about 1.1 million views on his own channel (2026-09-14), footage by Goldenvoice; Essential listening

known_gaps.title: Beyoncé, 2018
known_gaps.why: the performance every best-of list puts first; released as the Netflix film Homecoming, and a search for 'coachella' on her YouTube channel returned no upload of it; named in the text with the livestream figure, not embedded

known_gaps.title: Daft Punk, 2006
known_gaps.why: cited by Wikipedia as one of the festival's most memorable shows; no official upload found on the festival's channel; named in the text

known_gaps.title: Coachella 2026 full sets
known_gaps.why: the festival's channel carries 2026 playlists of full sets (Yuma, and Quasar, Do LaB, Day 0 and Sahara DJ sets, with HUGEL and Mahmut Orhan); their view counts were not read, so the listening uses the two most watched items found

known_gaps.title: Sabrina Carpenter x Madonna, 2026
known_gaps.why: 915,000 views on the festival's channel; a pop moment, not a set, and the listening block keeps to the festival's most watched and a full set
